description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to 'likes' on comments within the Buzz plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties and methods to specify filtering criteria such as comment ID and sorting options.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters on comment likes in the Buzz plugin, allowing filtering by comment ID and setting default sorting by liked timestamp.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets default sort field to 'commentLike.likedAtUtc'.

methods.name: getCommentId
methods.description: Getter method for retrieving the comment ID filter value.

methods.name: setCommentId
methods.description: Setter method for assigning the comment ID filter value.
